title: High-Precision Computation and PSLQ Identification of Stokes Multipliers for Anharmonic Oscillators
summary: We present a large-scale computational study combining arbitrary-precision arithmetic, sequence acceleration, and the PSLQ integer relation algorithm to discover exact closed-form expressions for fundamental constants arising in asymptotic analysis. We compute the Stokes multipliers C_M of the one-dimensional anharmonic oscillators H = p^2/2 + x^2/2 + g x^{2M} for M = 2, 3, ..., 11, extracting 17-30 significant digits from up to 1200 perturbation coefficients computed at 300-digit working precision.
